label: PF Backlog 444
title: WorkerGrid Stage 3a: Go coordinator service (parity + cutover)
body:
Source: WorkerGrid design docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md section 6/9.3 (Go target) + ADR-0001 (Go-first) / ADR-0002 (cut-over). User-approved plan 2026-10-07.

Goal: port the WorkerGrid coordinator service (Python spike: workergrid/service.py + workergrid/store.py) to a Go single static binary with behavior parity, then cut over (delete the Python service, wg.py serve becomes an exec-shim; single writer at any time).

In scope: (1) service-behavior contract tests first (currently ZERO tests cover the service), parameterized over the Python spike and the Go binary; (2) Go implementation in workergrid/ (go.mod, cmd/wg-coordinator, internal/{config,store,httpapi}) using pure-Go SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite, CGO_ENABLED=0), same schema + BEGIN IMMEDIATE claim semantics, same routes/JSON shapes/bearer auth; (3) cutover - delete service.py/store.py, exec-shim in wg.py, docs; (4) new gate scripts/dev/wg_go_check.py (go build/vet/test + contract suite) wired into precheck.

Out of scope: PostgreSQL store (3b), design-section-5 extras /report + /assignments (3b), worker agents (3c), binary distribution/release.

Accepted risk: first Go code in this repo (new-path approved by user); Go toolchain installed via winget (GoLang.Go).

**RCCA (envelope defect, found during Stage 3a parity work):** the Stage 2b `_assign` read `r['data']` one level too shallow - PF's `/api/v1/engineering/schedule/next` returns the canonical envelope `{request_id, status, data:{found, item, title, pidl_context, execution_policy}}`, so `/work` would always have returned "no eligible work". Fixed in the Python spike before the port (unwrap one level when `found` is absent and `data.data` is a dict); the Go `internal/httpapi` mirrors the same unwrap. Guard: the cross-impl contract suite (test_workergrid_service_contract.py, gate wg_go_check) pins the assignment + pidl passthrough behavior on every run.

**Cutover (Stage 3a):** `workergrid/service.py` + `workergrid/store.py` deleted; `wg.py serve` exec-shims to `bin/wg-coordinator` (fail-closed build hint); `pidl_synthesis_check.py` now verifies passthrough in `internal/httpapi/httpapi.go`.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/design_critic.py, core/design_tokens.py, core/product_design_spec.py

_note: Stage 3a: Go port + contract parity + cutover landed; gates next

dashboard_impact.reason: WorkerGrid coordination service is an external execution-plane component; no dashboard surface (operator surface is the /wg command + service API)
